                                            [--full-report]

                                            --set PARAMETER |
                                            --change NAME=VALUE |
                                            --aim TARGET_SELECTION |
                                            --attach TARGET_SELECTION |
                                            --detach |
                                            --bind-end TARGET_SELECTION |
                                            --unbind-end | --remove)
                                            [--cascade] [--orient {opposed}]
                                            [--self-anchor SELF_ANCHOR]
                                            [--target-anchor TARGET_ANCHOR]
                                            [--inset INSET] [--value VALUE]
                                            [--amount AMOUNT] --reason REASON
                                            scene

positional arguments:
  scene

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --outdir OUTDIR
  --svg-only
  --full-report         print the complete scene report instead of focused
                        feedback
  --selection SELECTION
  --move {left,right,up,down}
  --set PARAMETER       a semantic control exposed by inspect
  --change NAME=VALUE   repeat for one coherent multi-control preview;
                        accept/undo as one edit
  --aim TARGET_SELECTION
                        fit an inspected connected stroke terminal direction
                        while keeping both endpoints
  --attach TARGET_SELECTION
                        pin to a target inspected with --feature anchors
  --detach              release an inspected mount while preserving current
                        placement
  --bind-end TARGET_SELECTION
                        bind the inspected stroke root/tip to a separately
                        inspected target mount
  --unbind-end          release the inspected root/tip while preserving the
                        current curve
  --remove              remove the inspected whole object; affected surviving
                        links release in place
  --cascade             with --remove, also remove all attached descendants
  --orient {opposed}    with --attach, persistently oppose a directional joint
                        to its target
  --self-anchor SELF_ANCHOR
                        named mount on this object (defaults to inspected
                        mount, else center)
  --target-anchor TARGET_ANCHOR
                        named mount on target object (defaults to inspected
                        mount, else center)
  --inset INSET         -2..2 into target surface, fraction of its nominal
                        shorter extent; negative leaves a gap
  --value VALUE         numeric value, hairstyle name or hex colour for --set
  --amount AMOUNT       lock/spine: nominal width/thickness; object/stroke
                        terminal: shorter canvas; digit tip: nominal span
                        (default .10)
  --reason REASON
